note: Inyo NF campground in the Mammoth Lakes Basin: a long strip of sites in pine forest along Mammoth and Coldwater Creeks just below Lake Mary, with the Duck Pass trailhead at the south end. High bear activity: food and scented items go in the site's bear locker. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov read. $33 confirmed, +$10 extra vehicle. 77 sites (74 on rec.gov), max 43. Toilets vault -> flush (both FS and rec.gov). No hookups or showers. Season 05-28..09-25, seasonally closed now. Creekside KEPT (sites 008/009/043/045). Pin ~550 m off (at the trailhead).
flags: WATERFRONT creekside KEPT: Mammoth Creek, a perennial creek well under 30 m wide, runs 15-26 m from sites 009 (37.59869,-118.99535), 008 (37.59849,-118.99518), 043 (37.59573,-118.99290) and 045 (37.59600,-118.99320) on NHD flowlines. 3DEP shows a 0.5-2.6 m drop, an easy walk down. All four are reservable nightly on recreation.gov. The canopy hides the channel on Esri, so this rests on NHD + lidar + rec.gov ('Coldwater and Mammoth Creeks run alongside the campsites'). Replacement evidence: 'NHD + 3DEP 2026-11-27: Mammoth Creek 15-26 m from rec.gov sites 008/009/043/045 (37.5985,-118.9952; 37.5957,-118.9929), 0.5-2.6 m drop; canopy-blind on Esri; rec.gov: creeks run alongside the campsites.'

PIN MOVE (~550 m): stored 37.59200,-118.98930 is past the south end of the loop near the Duck Pass trailhead, ~70 m beyond the last site (063). Target 37.5956,-118.9936, the FS page's own point, ~40 m from the catalog-site centroid (37.5951,-118.9928).
FACILITIES: stored vault_toilets came from note prose. The FS page and rec.gov both say flush toilets, so vault_toilets is cleared.
STATUS: FS 'Site Closed' is the seasonal closure (the season ended 2026-09-26), so status is not set.
PHONE: 760-924-5500 (Mammoth Lakes Welcome Center) is confirmed on the FS page. Rec.gov also gives the concessionaire's campground office, 760-934-5795; it is optional to note.
